summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 4 NEW features in LabStock app: (1) Printable Labels, (2) Usage Trends, (3) Email Digest (preview-only), (4) Purchase Orders. All backend APIs (65/65 tests) and frontend functionality working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/usage-trends returns correct structure with daily (days+1 points), by_item, total_used, active_reagents
Backend: POST /api/purchase-orders creates PO with auto po_number, status='draft', calculated total_cost
Backend: GET /api/purchase-orders lists all POs
Backend: GET /api/purchase-orders/{id} returns single PO
Backend: PUT /api/purchase-orders/{id} updates status to 'ordered' and sets ordered_at timestamp
Backend: POST /api/purchase-orders/{id}/receive marks as 'received', sets received_at, and adds ordered qty to stock
Backend: DELETE /api/purchase-orders/{id} removes PO
Backend: GET /api/settings returns digest_recipient and digest_time
Backend: PUT /api/settings (admin) updates settings successfully
Backend: PUT /api/settings (tech) returns 403 Forbidden
Backend: GET /api/digest returns preview with recipient, schedule, low_stock, expiring, summary
Backend: POST /api/digest/send returns ok=false, provider_configured=false (preview-only as expected)
Frontend: Labels page - Item labels tab loads with item list
Frontend: Labels page - Selecting items shows barcode preview cards (tested 1 item and all 15 items)
Frontend: Labels page - Location labels tab loads with textarea input
Frontend: Labels page - Editing location input regenerates location label preview cards (tested 3 locations)
Frontend: Reports page - Usage trends tab shows KPIs (Total consumed: 35, Active reagents: 3)
Frontend: Reports page - Daily consumption area chart renders correctly
Frontend: Reports page - Top consumed reagents bar chart renders correctly
Frontend: Reports page - Days selector changes data (tested 7, 30, 90 days)
Frontend: Reports page - Email digest tab shows preview banner with correct message
Frontend: Reports page - Digest recipient and time inputs visible (test@lab.com, 10:00)
Frontend: Reports page - Low stock table and Expiring table render correctly
Frontend: Reports page - Send digest button shows info toast about preview-only (expected behavior)
Frontend: Purchase Orders page - PO table displays existing POs
Frontend: Purchase Orders page - Create PO dialog opens with prefilled reorder suggestions (2 lines)
Frontend: Purchase Orders page - Creating PO with supplier 'Acme Labs' shows success toast
Frontend: Purchase Orders page - View PO dialog opens and displays PO details
Frontend: Purchase Orders page - Mark ordered button changes status to 'ordered' with toast notification
Frontend: Purchase Orders page - Receive button (with confirm dialog) changes status to 'received' and updates stock
